WITH scoped AS (
SELECT f.market_ticker,f.kalshi_order_id,o.strategy,o.experiment_deployment_arm_id
FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
), markets AS (
SELECT s.market_ticker,count(DISTINCT (s.strategy,s.experiment_deployment_arm_id)) AS executed_mmsell_owners,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT (x.strategy,x.experiment_deployment_arm_id)) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.market_ticker=s.market_ticker) AS order_owners,
count(*) AS scoped_fills,
(SELECT count(*) FROM fills f WHERE f.market_ticker=s.market_ticker) AS all_source_fills
FROM scoped s GROUP BY s.market_ticker
)
SELECT order_owners,executed_mmsell_owners,scoped_fills=all_source_fills AS scoped_contains_all_source_fills,
count(*) AS markets FROM markets WHERE order_owners<>1 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY markets DESC
